references.text: Parallel in military strategy: Dividing forces to attack the enemy at night or from an ambush.
Thematic parallel: Victory and prolonged pursuit of enemies over vast geographical areas.
Strong narrative parallel: Total victory and prolonged pursuit of enemies until they are destroyed.
Parallel in military tactics: Dividing forces to lie in wait and launch an attack.
Theological parallel: God grants His anointed one/leader a overwhelming victory against superior forces.
Theological parallel: God grants His anointed one victory over superior forces as a sign of His faithfulness.
